buildSteps.label: The frames
buildSteps.description: Each run has a folder under data/captures/tutorial-agents: a screenshot of every step, a report, and a contact sheet that opens in a browser.

buildSteps.label: What it fixed
buildSteps.description: Layout and code, without asking: overflow, a file that is missing, an error in the console.

buildSteps.label: What it asked
buildSteps.description: Wording. It shortened the title because you said it may. Otherwise it proposes, and waits for you.

buildSteps.label: Your part
buildSteps.description: Open the contact sheet. A clean report does not show a slide that is legible but wrong.
